full_page.content:
Page 47
May 9 Grace Rithoret - 43 - (womb) cancer given up by doctors as hopeless. Enrolled in Ser. Mass Ass'n perpetually last evening, found improving when husband and daughter went home. - Husband went to sacraments To- day first in 20 yrs.
12 able to walk home from hospital to-day
13 Here To-day smiling - Both go to confession
10 Caspar W. Peitz - 52 - until late years seeming a practical Catholic till.
Amelia Oberman - 34 - asks prayers to start order
May 11 Mary McCormick - 5 - measles Spinal manen. - sleeping sickness - slept for two weeks in Kiefer Hosp. now home and brighter than ever - 6 week ago To-day we asked for pp. and enrolled her. Deo Gratias
20 Here To-day bright and alert & happy. Deo Gr.
Page 48
May 10 Mrs. Mary Gallinagh - 30 - Enemia baby 3 weeks - Husband nerveous breakdown
12 Clara Brzowiski - 29 - Eczima doctoring 3 yrs. nothing help ... En- rolls Today promising more frequent Communion & perpetual enroll- ment.
Frances Rybinski - 70 - serious nerveous breakdown - in Eloise.
14 Mrs. Mary Schafer - 38 - goitre & nerve-trouble. Her mother 74 dy- ing of cancer admonished, even under a "hipo" to go over to the Mon- astery. Here To-day
Udavilla Skinner - 35 - nerveous for a long time unable to go to holy Communion. Enrolled last July and drove to church and went to H. Com- munion next day .....
Mrs. Julia Sarsfield of Washington D. C. - 28 - rushed to hospital for operation (had friends) phoned - of terrible pains. Cath. Andley phoned to have her enrolled .... kept in Hospital till 3rd day nothing found was sent home without any operation.
Page 49 May 16 Mrs. Martha Martin - 69- throat cancer can take only just a little milk with water; suffer since about last Thanksgiving Day.
